newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Oct 29.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Oct 29.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Tuesday:
* On Monday, the Dow Jones dropped by 34.29 points to 5,972.73. PLDT's ADR fell by $ 1 to $57 1/4.
* The peso closed at 26.285 to a U.S.dollar from 26.284.
* The Philippine Stock Exchange index closed at 2,852.16, down 110.44.
* The Philippine interbank call loan rate dropped to 11.09375 percent from 11.0625.

* Dharmala Securities analysts in their outlook for Tuesday said: "The breakdown of the key support level at 2,855 suggests that the market still has momentum to continue its downward trek. Next support is at 2,766 which is the 50 percent retracement of the whole upmove from 2,153 to 3,378 (Nov 21, 1995 to July 5, 1996). Expect bargain hunting as we closely reach those levels."

* But brokerage Sun Hung Kai Securities thought there could be a rebound. "The market may experience a rebound as a result of this steep drop which may encourage bargain hunting especially on hard hit counters such as PNB, PLDT and ALIB. However, consolidation is still seen for the short term," a Sun Hung Kai report said.
